smartSearch.title: Smart Search
smartSearch.description: Use personalized filters to instantly explore options based on room type, budget, location, and available services.

verified.title: Verified Options
verified.description: All dorms listed on the platform are approved and licensed by the Ministry of Youth and Sports, ensuring a reliable and safe experience.

tracking.title: Easy Tracking
tracking.description: Follow every step of your booking, payment, and check-in process through a simple, user-friendly dashboard. You can also manage housing services during your stay directly through the system.

payments.title: Secure Payment Methods
payments.description: Complete your booking through the platform with safe and flexible payment options—Bank transfer, direct payment via the platform, or on-site payment.

support.title: 24/7 Support
support.description: Our dedicated team is available at all times to provide full assistance and ensure a smooth, comfortable student living experience.

ai.title: AI-Powered Recommendations
ai.description: Our system uses artificial intelligence to analyze your preferences—such as university location, budget, and lifestyle—to recommend the most suitable dorms for your needs. Find your ideal housing faster and smarter with Edmovinn.
